draft.text: You came in because you have been having pain on your right side.
An ultrasound showed your right kidney is smaller than your left and has cysts.
It also found swollen lymph nodes.
You have an infection, but we are not sure where it is.
The ultrasound did not show signs of infection or blockage in your urinary tract.
The next steps will be discussed with your doctor.

unverified_summary.text: You came in because you have been having pain on your right side.
At first, it was thought to be a stomach virus.
An ultrasound showed your right kidney is smaller than your left and has cysts.
There are also cysts on your ovaries and swollen lymph nodes.
You may have an infection, but it is not clear if it is in your kidney or another part of your urinary tract.
Your kidney function seems okay, and your blood pressure is normal.
The next steps will be discussed with your doctor.
